Wishaway — identity for a crystalware brand.

Wishaway sells spiritually-charged crystalware — natural stone and crystals meant to bring calm. The identity: a gold mark of a robed figure rising inside a crescent, chosen from eight routes, carried onto a trifold and a gold-and-pattern catalogue.

The identity and collateral are mine; the crystalware is the brand's own.

Branding & graphics — Anirudh Kapoor. A·49.
